crossRefs.note: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.
Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.”…
Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of…
My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to…
Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?
Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the…
I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God…
Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

translations.web: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;
translations.bsb: While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab,
translations.kjv: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
